use IO.Std.write_line

binomial(n: int, k: int) -> long is
    assert k >= 0 /\ k <= n else "k must lie between 0 and n"

    let smaller = if k > n - k then n - k else k fi
    let result mut = 1L

    for i in 0..smaller do
        result = result * cast(n - i) / cast(i + 1)
    od

    result
si

for (n, k) in [(5, 3), (10, 5), (60, 30)] do
    write_line("C({n}, {k}) = {binomial(n, k)}")
od
